FN-V76G7LL-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 247
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Phillip Pettus
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 01/21/2026
House Bill 247 as passed the House of Representatives would increase the obligations of the
State General Fund, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, by $156,985 for each state death benefit
payment paid to a surviving beneficiary or dependent of a volunteer firefighter that dies as a
result of a work-related cancer, under certain conditions.
Page 1
